profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Akkodis
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer (front-end focused) with 17+ years of experience building and scaling modern web applications using React/Next.js, Angular and Typescript ecosystems and back-end for the ones. Proven track record of delivering high-quality, mobile-ready web solutions using SPA and micro-frontend architectures, developing UI component libraries and doing headless CMS integrations for large clients in finance, e-commerce, media, automotive, and intelligence domains. Comfortable working in cloud-native environments such as AWS and Microsoft Azure and collaborating with DevOps teams on containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes). Strong collaborator in distributed teams, comfortable driving architecture and design discussions, mentoring junior developers, and owning features end-to-end from requirements to production. Passionate about clean, safe, high-performance and testable code, security and building robust design-system-driven interfaces. Experienced in API development and integration, database development and data management (NoSQL/ ORM/SQL/GraphQL). Details oriented with a good eye on UI. Strong team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision with a strong eye for details.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Client: Charles Schwab | Remote

• Take part in frontend development of a Design System, designing reusable web components to use in Sanity and company’s websites to display static content.
• Participate in architecting micro-frontend shell (routing, shared state, auth/session). • Architect and implement complex user interfaces, set standards for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
 • Build a library of responsive, reusable and user-friendly React/Next.js components and Tailwind-based layouts, improving consistency across new features and reducing UI development time for new screens.
 • Apply accessibility standards (WCAG/ARIA).
 • Integrate Sanity CMS using GROQ queries and Sanity client APIs to manage static content.
 • Build dynamic CMS-driven pages.
 • Create reusable UI components that support static-site rendering (SSR) for structured CMS content.
 • Implement dynamic routing, draft preview, and content revalidation.
 • Render rich text content with Sanity Portable Text.
 • Optimize CMS images, SEO metadata, and page performance.
 • Maintain type-safe CMS data handling with TypeScript.
 • Collaborate with content editors, designers, and developers to improve CMS workflows.
 • Debug CMS data-fetching and front-end rendering issues.
 • Optimize data fetching and caching strategy which made the UI feel noticeably more responsive under heavy data loads.
 • Partner with backend engineers to design and evolve our platform capabilities.
 • Build and maintain Storybook documentation for the new design system components, providing interactive examples and usage guidance to streamline handoffs and improve component reuse.
 • Use AI and AI tools for project structure and code optimization, routing operations, components and tests code generation, code reviewing, etc.
 • Create unit and end-to-end tests, perform code reviews, and suggest refactors.
 • Mentor engineers on performance profiling and React design patterns, elevate team’s delivery quality.
positions.insights: Skills: React · React Custom Hooks · React Hooks · React Forms · Next.js · TypeScript · Playwright · GitHub · Figma · WCAG · Tailwind CSS · Storybook · Sanity CMS · GROQ · Shadcn

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend
positions.description:
·     Led the frontend development of a Persona Dashboard ERP platform, designing role-specific KPI views that made complex operational data easier to understand and act on for employees, managers and executives.
·     Participated in architecting micro-frontend shell (routing, shared state, auth/session).
·     Architected and implemented complex user interfaces, set standards for accessibility, performance, and responsive design while mentoring others on best practices.
·     Built a library of responsive, reusable and user-friendly React/Next.js components and Tailwind-based layouts, improving consistency across new features and reducing UI development time for new screens.
·     Applied accessibility standards (WCAG/ARIA).
·     Integrated the dashboards with a RESTfull API (BFF) and implemented secure authentication flows with Azure MSAL (JWT), improving reliability and reducing auth-related issues reported by users.
·     Optimized data fetching and caching with ReactQuery and centralized state handling with Zustand, which made the UI feel noticeably more responsive under heavy data loads.
·     Partnered with backend engineers to design, develop and evolve our platform capabilities.
·     Used AI for structuring code and its optimization, components and tests code generation, code reviewing, etc.
·     Built and maintained Storybook documentation for new design-system components, providing interactive examples and usage guidance to streamline handoffs and improve component reuse.
·     Raised code quality by adding unit and end-to-end tests around core components, performing code reviews, and suggesting refactors that simplified complex logic and made future changes safer.
·     Mentored engineers on performance profiling and React design patterns, elevated team’s delivery quality.
·     Optimized and evolved our CI/CD infrastructure Azure Cloud infrastructure, driving improvements in build times, deployment reliability, and developer experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Single Page Applications · monorepo · ReactQuery · React · React Hooks · Next.js · React.js · HTML · Playwright · Microsoft Azure · Git · npm · Webpack Module Federation · Tailwind CSS · reCharts · MSAL · TypeScript · Custom Hook · Reacharts · WCAG · JWT · Zustand · Agile · T-SQL · SQL Server · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · GitHub Copilot

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack
positions.description:
Client: Domino’s | Remote

·     Contributed to the end-to-end redesign of Domino’s online ordering experience using a micro-frontend architecture, ensuring each part of the flow was modular, testable, and easy to evolve.
·     Developed several micro-frontends dedicated to distinct stages of the ordering process, efficiently managing shared state and navigation to deliver an integrated and seamless customer experience.
·     Used xState machines to model complex UI flows and error states, improving reliability and making business logic easier to reason about and extend.
·     Customized Tailwind CSS styles and built Storybook-documented library of responsive, reusable web components, which helped align the implementation with design and reduced rework from misinterpretation.
·     Utilized GraphQL in conjunction with the Apollo client to efficiently query and perform data mutations.
·     Improved front-/back-end architecture over time including patterns, tooling, testing and reliability.
·     Implemented accessibility baseline (focus management, ARIA patterns, keyboard flows) and added automated checks in CI.
·     Strengthened confidence in releases by adding unit, integration and end-to-end tests for critical paths, catching regressions earlier in the pipeline.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Front-End
positions.description:
Client: Vanguard

•	Developed and maintained a reusable Angular component library (published as an internal npm package) used across multiple Vanguard web applications, improving consistency and speeding up feature delivery.
•	Built Angular components, services, and styles aligned with accessibility and design-system guidelines, resulting in cleaner, more maintainable UI codebases.
•	Contributed to the evolution of existing design system and frontend architecture to enhance scalability, maintainability, and developer experience.
•	Applied accessibility standards (WCAG/ARIA).
•	Leveraged Storybook to catalogue, demo, and document newly created Angular components for the design library, accelerating adoption and ensuring consistent UI usage across teams.
•	Worked with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) to define templates, policies, and page structures, enabling content authors to build pages without developer intervention.
•	Maintained high standards of code quality through unit and end-to-end testing and code reviews.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Client: Covius

•	Contributed to the development of a real-estate auction platform by translating Figma designs into a library of high-quality, responsive, and reusable React components, ensuring alignment with design specifications and seamless functionality across multiple devices.
•	Developed custom hooks to optimise code efficiency and minimise redundancy.
•	Developed new business processes and user interface flows, integrating the frontend with existing RESTful APIs and addressing edge cases in user interactions.
•	Collaborated closely with founders to scope, prioritize, and ship new features fast.
•	Collaborated closely with designers and stakeholders to refine UX, iterate on layout and interaction details, and address issues quickly based on feedback.
•	Applied accessibility standards (WCAG/ARIA).
•	Developed and integrated a proprietary RESTful API to facilitate efficient data retrieval and modification processes.
•	Writing unit, integration and end-to-end tests to provide high code quality standards.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Engineer
positions.description:
•	Took part in development and enhancement of the Cortex Enterprise Intelligence Platform (EIP), designing user interface workflows that enabled government and commercial clients to efficiently ingest, explore, and visualize extensive and varied data sets.
•	Partnered with product owners and domain experts to clarify requirements, propose UI/UX improvements, and estimate effort, helping shape realistic roadmaps and priorities.
•	Developed Angular-based features with TypeScript, SASS, Material UI, RxJS, and REST APIs, including custom components, directives, and pipes tailored to complex data exploration use cases.
•	Played a key role in introducing and expanding React within the platform, including building reusable component library with React, custom hooks and Redux for new modules.
•	Integrated external visualization tools and internal APIs, and optimized rendering performance so the UI remained responsive even when dealing with large result sets.
•	Maintained high standards of code quality through unit and end-to-end testing, code reviews, and ongoing refactoring of legacy code to more modern patterns.

interface for alignment, variant calling, gene expression, annotation, and deep analytics – empowered
by powerful data tracking and management.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Front-End
positions.description:
• Built large-scale web application (in-house CMS) and company’s website using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, AngularJS, Underscore, Microsoft ASP.NET (MVC, C#) and Web API.
• Developed W3C compliant web pages from layered PSD utilizing HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript/ jQuery.
• Researched and implemented new technologies including isomorphic JavaScript and MVC frameworks.
• Led remote outsource developer’s team.
• Mentored and trained other developers, conduct code review, and lead weekly front-end developer meeting.
• Presented to business stakeholders and other developers.
• Wrote technical documents.
• Functional, integration and unit testing using Protractor/Jasmine and nUnit.
• Code optimizing, debugging, testing and troubleshooting.
positions.insights: Skills: Single Page Applications · Backbone.js · ASP.NET Web API · HTML5 · C# · JavaScript · CSS
